description: §8.10 Tier 2 loop hoisting (RUNTIME, sqlEngine:"real"): the planner accepts a loop whose single keyed read is `return ?{…}.get()` inside an `if` — a site the body rewrite has no Map-lookup form for. The loop is emitted UN-hoisted, with its per-iteration query, so the read returns the row. Pre-S455 the loop was hoisted anyway, the read was left in place and emitted with no server boundary — `return null; // SQL — client cannot evaluate` — so the function returned `not` on success ("none").
rationale: §8.10.3: "The rewritten loop is observationally equivalent to the un-rewritten loop on all side-effect orderings." A rewrite that cannot preserve the read is not the §8.10.2 rewrite; the un-rewritten loop is the correct emission.
